description:
Model checking that gets issues solved

BIMcollab Zoom is the only model checking solution smoothly integrated with BIM coordination. Easily combine models, analyze object properties and find clashes faster than ever with intuitive model checking.
Find issues, communicate them and verify solutions. Visualize and share customized views with stakeholders and empower them to address design issues in the early stages of the project.
Features / improvements
- IDS property validation improvements
  - Specifications with optional, required, and prohibited applicability and/or requirements are now supported.
  - Validation of specifications with the “Part Of” facet has been extended to include “ifcRelVoidsElement” and “ifcRelFillsElement”.
- Improved support for materials in IFC 4 and 4.3 files
  - Materials defined by “ifcMaterialConstituent” are now available.
  - Properties from material property sets are now available.
  - The material attributes “Category” and “Description” have been added.

Minor changes
- Improved and updated List results component.
- Adjustable column widths of List results (Windows).
- Re-download models of online projects from the context menu.
- Improved Smart Issue synchronization to reduce project loading time.
- Improved Smart Issue synchronization to avoid missing conflict information in new Smart Issues.
- Extended “Part Of” information with the relationships “ifcRelVoidsElement” and “ifcRelFillsElement”.
- Addressed several security and vulnerability concerns.
- Updated several third-party libraries.

Bug fixes
- Fixed a problem where measurements could no longer be snapped to section planes.
- Fixed a problem with opening hyperlinks from the property panel.
- Fixed a problem with running BIMcollab Zoom on MacOS Sonoma.
- Fixed a problem where grid labels were not visible.
